title: Secondary share marketplaces say OpenAI shares have fallen out of favor, in some cases becoming difficult to unload, as investors pivot quickly to Anthropic (Hema Parmar/Bloomberg)
summary: Hema Parmar / Bloomberg: Secondary share marketplaces say OpenAI shares have fallen out of favor, in some cases becoming difficult to unload, as investors pivot quickly to Anthropic — OpenAI shares have fallen out of favor on the secondary market — in some cases becoming almost impossible to unload …
